cards.title: 1.1 Fundamentals of HCI

blocks.text: Human-Computer Interaction
(HCI) is the study and design of technology so that it serves people.

Achha HCI system = easy to use, efficient, insani zaroorat pe · responsive. Doosre naam: CHI (Computer-Human Interface), MMI · (Man-Machine Interaction) — teeno ka matlab: insaan aur machine · ka milna.
Sight · screen, video
Touch · tap, haptics
Spatial · VR movement
HUMAN
Hearing · speaker · Voice · "Alexa…"
Yaad rakho: HCI = CHI = MMI → "Human meets Machine". Paanch channels S-T-H-V-S: Sight, Touch, Hearing, Voice, Spatial.

HCI matlab CHI matlab MMI phir "Human meets Machine". Paanch channels S-T-H-V-S: Sight, Touch, Hearing, Voice, Spatial. HCI insaan aur system ka milaap hai: dekhna, sunna, chhuna, aur harkat.

cards.title: 1.4 Importance of HCI

blocks.text: HCI ensures that machines are approachable and usable, turning complex technology into everyday tools.
Achha design → aasaan aur mazedaar (touchscreens). Bura · design → uljhan aur khatra (medical device pe ghair-wazeh · buttons). Is liye HCI sajawat nahi, zaroorat hai.
Implication · Matlab
1. Enhance · Productivity
Tez kaam, kam ghaltiyan, goals jaldi
2. Promotes · Inclusivity
Screen readers, voice commands — har kisi ke · liye barabar istemaal
3. Drives Innovation · AR/VR, AI, IoT tabhi apnaye jayenge jab HCI · mazboot ho
4. Economic impact · User-friendly product → zyada adoption, loyalty, · munafa
5. Ethical · responsibility
Privacy ka ehtiraam, bias kam, insani behbood
Yaad rakho: P-I-I-E-E: "Please Include Innovative, Ethical
Earnings."
Paper mein: 8 marks: "Why is HCI important? Discuss its implications." Opening (achha vs bura design) + 5 numbered points, har ek ki misaal.

cards.title: 1.5 Accessibility Principles

blocks.text: Accessibility principles are HCI guidelines that ensure digital systems are usable by all individuals, including people with diverse physical, sensory and cognitive abilities.
Principle · Matlab · Misaal
Contrast · Text/tasveer background · se wazeh
Railway app: safed pe · kala text, dhoop mein bhi
Fonts · Saaf, saada font, sahih · size/spacing
School site pe bara · Calibri
Colour-blind · friendly
Sirf rang pe bharosa nahi · — symbol/label bhi
Laal circle + "STOP" label
Navigation · Ghoomne ke kai tareeqe · Mouse na ho to Tab key · se buttons
Multimodal · Kai formats (dekhna, · sunna, choona)
Video captions, phone · vibration
Yaad rakho: C-F-C-N-M: "Can Friends Catch New Messages?"

cards.narration: 1.5 Accessibility Principles. Definition ka matlab yeh hai. Accessibility principles woh HCI guidelines hain jo yaqeen dilati hain ke digital systems sab logon ke liye usable hon, jin mein alag alag physical, sensory aur cognitive abilities wale log bhi shamil hain. Principle, Matlab, Misaal. Contrast, Text ya tasveer background se wazeh. Railway app: safed pe, kala text, dhoop mein bhi. Fonts. Saaf, saada font, sahih size ya spacing. School site pe bara, Calibri. Colour-blind friendly. Sirf rang pe bharosa nahi,, symbol ya label bhi. Laal circle + "STOP" label. Navigation. Ghoomne ke kai tareeqe. Accessibility gaps · Video tutorial bina captions (behre users)
Compatibility · issues
Laptop pe chale, mobile browser pe crash

blocks.text: UI design is the process of creating and organizing the visual elements of a software application so users can interact with it easily and efficiently.

Submit · Cancel · ← Buttons
Component · Kaam
Buttons · Click se action (Submit, Cancel)
Menus · Options ki list — navigation
Icons · Tools/actions ke chhote symbols
Text fields · Type karne ke dabbe (password, search)
Checkbox / Radio · Checkbox = kai choices; radio = group mein sirf ek
Sliders · Bar pe value (volume, brightness)
UI (User Interface) · UX (User Experience)
Jo dikhta hai — rang, buttons, · icons, layout
Jo mehsoos hota hai — poora safar, · aasaani, satisfaction
Tool: Figma (visual design) · Research, interviews, testing
Misaal: JazzCash ka · khoobsurat "Send" button
Kya paisa 3 taps mein bina ghabrahat · ke chala gaya?

cards.title: 2.1.1 Trace Tables

blocks.text: A trace table is a technique used to monitor how the values of variables change during the execution of an algorithm.
Kaam: dry running (haath se line-by-line), debugging (logical · errors), validation (wahi kare jo chahiye). Columns: line/step · · variables · condition check · input/output.
Step · height · 1.57 ≤ h ≤ 1.91? · Total · Output
Yaad rakho: Har baar variable badle ya condition test ho → nayi row. Na badalne wali values neeche copy karo.
Paper mein: "Dry-run using a trace table and state the output" —
har variable ka column + condition column + aakhir mein output.

cards.narration: 2.1.1 Trace Tables. Yeh golden point hai, paper mein aksar aata hai. Definition ka matlab yeh hai. Trace table ek technique hai jo algorithm ke execution ke dauran variables ki values ke badalne ko monitor karti hai. Kaam: dry running (haath se line-by-line), debugging (logical. Errors), validation (wahi kare jo chahiye). Columns: line ya step variables condition check input ya output. Code example. AllHeights matlab [1.91, 2.01, 1.87, 1.57, 1.48]. Total matlab 0. For height in AllHeights. If height > matlab 1.57 and height < matlab 1.91. Total matlab Total + 1. Print(Total). Step height, 1.57 ≤ h ≤ 1.91?, Total, Output. 1, 1.True, 1. 2, 2.False, 1. 3, 1.True, 2. 4, 1.True, 3. 5, 1.False, 3 end, 3, 3. Yaad rakho. Har baar variable badle ya condition test ho phir nayi row. Na badalne wali values neeche copy karo. Paper mein aise poochte hain. "Dry-run using a trace table and state the output",. Har variable ka column + condition column + aakhir mein output. Trace table mein har line ke baad variables ki value likhi hoti hai. Andaza nahi, likha hua hisaab.

cards.title: Big-O growth

blocks.text: From fastest to slowest as \(n\) grows: \(O(1)\), \(O(\log n)\), \(O(n)\), \(O(n \log n)\), \(O(n^{2})\), \(O(2^{n})\).

cards.narration: Big-O growth. Yeh golden point hai, paper mein aksar aata hai. Jaise jaise n barhta hai, tez se dheemi growth yeh hai: O(1), O( log n), O(n), O(n log n), O(n ki power 2), O(2 ki power n). Table yaad karo. Columns hain: Class, Typical case, jab n double ho. O(1). Read one array slot. Same time. O( log n). Binary search. One extra step. O(n). Linear search, one loop. About twice. O(n log n). Efficient sorts. A bit more than twice. O(n ki power 2). Nested loops, bubble sort. About four times.

cards.title: 3.6 The with Statement (Context Manager)

blocks.text: The with statement is a context manager: it opens the file, runs the indented block, and always closes the file when the block ends — even if an error occurs.
with open(...) as f → f use karo → block khatam → file auto-close ✔
.close() bhoolna aasaan; crash pe file adhuri/kharab ho sakti.
with open("myfile.txt", "w") as f: · f.write("Context managers are safe!\n") · # yahan close() ki zaroorat nahi with open("myfile.txt", "r") as f: · for line in f: · print(line.strip())
Manual open/close · with close() khud likhna · Khud-ba-khud close
Error pe file khuli reh sakti · Error pe bhi close
Zyada lines · Saaf, chhota
Yaad rakho: with = "lo, use karo, wapas rakho". Mode phir bhi aap chuno: 'r', 'w', 'a'.
Paper mein: Context manager jo close guarantee kare; manual se farq; 4-line program with + write.

cards.title: 3.8 Errors & Exceptions (try-except)

blocks.text: Exception = program chalte waqt error (missing file). Handle na · karo → traceback + program ruk jata. try/except pakar ke saaf · message dikhata.
Yaad rakho: try = koshish; except = backup plan. Specific pehle, general Exception baad mein.

cards.narration: 3.8 Errors & Exceptions (try-except). Exception matlab program chalte waqt error (missing file). Handle na. Karo phir traceback + program ruk jata. Try ya except pakar ke saaf message dikhata. Code example. Try. With open("missing_data.txt", "r") as f. Print(f.read). Except FileNotFoundError. Print("Error: file does not exist."). Except Exception as e. Print(f"Unexpected error: {{e}}"). Else. Print("Read OK") # error na aaye to. Finally. Print("Done") # hamesha. Table yaad karo. Columns hain: Error, Matlab. FileNotFoundError. Specific pehle, general Exception baad mein. Try mein risk wala code. Except error pakadta hai. Finally dono sooraton mein chalta hai.

cards.title: 4.2 SQLite Database in Python

blocks.text: Built-in; poora DB ek .db file — na password, na server. Steps: · connect → cursor → execute → commit → fetchall → close.

import sqlite3 conn = sqlite3.connect("school.db") cur = conn.cursor() cur.execute("""CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS students (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, marks INTEGER)""") cur.execute("INSERT INTO students " "(name, marks) VALUES ('Ali', 85)") conn.commit()                 # disk pe likho cur.execute("SELECT * FROM students") print(cur.fetchall())         # [(1, 'Ali', 85)] conn.close()                  # free + unlock
Yaad rakho: SQL ke andar strings single quotes: 'Ali'. SELECT * = sab columns.

cards.title: 5.3.1 Secure Collaboration

blocks.text: Secure collaboration means using digital tools to work together in a safe, controlled and responsible way.
Files share, online classes, documents mil ke edit — faida tabhi jab · data mehfooz ho.
Element · Sawal / matlab · Misaal
Authentication · "Tum kaun ho?" — pehchan · verify
Password, fingerprint, · MFA
Access control · "Tum kya kar sakte ho?" — · permissions
Teacher edit, student · sirf view
Accountability · Kis ne kya kiya — record · Activity logs, version · history
Privacy · Sirf zaroori logon se share · "Anyone with link" · band
Safe · transmission
Raste mein data encrypted · HTTPS, encrypted · chat
MFA (Multi-Factor Authentication) = kam az kam do alag qisam ke · factors. 2FA = exactly do (password + OTP).
Dhoka: Do passwords = 2FA nahi (dono "know" qisam ke). Factors alag qisam ke hone chahiye.
Yaad rakho: A-A-A-P-S. Authentication = darwaze pe pehchan; access control = andar kaunse kamre khulein.
Paper mein: "Define secure collaboration", "authentication vs access control", "What is MFA/2FA?", "5 elements with examples".
